client.home.title: Larynx — Your people, together
client.home.description: A home for your conversations, plans, and shared moments. Larynx is in early development.
client.home.eyebrow: A LITTLE CLOSER TO YOUR PEOPLE
client.home.heading: Good things start with a conversation.
client.home.intro: Your chats, the plans that grow from them, and the moments you share. Together in one place.
client.home.accountReady: Your account is ready to set up. Conversations and shared plans are coming next.
client.home.conversationsDetail: A familiar place for your people, with chat at the heart of it.
client.home.plansDetail: Turn the things you talk about into time spent together.
client.home.memoriesDetail: Keep the moments connected to the people who were there.
client.account.title: Your account
client.account.description: A place for your identity and the devices you use to connect.
client.account.signInDescription: Sign in or create an account securely. Account recovery is available on the sign-in page.
client.account.recoveryWarning: Recovery restores access to your account. Encrypted history recovery is not yet available.
client.account.verified: Your account is verified. Manage the devices that can access it below.
client.account.recoveryComplete: Account recovery is complete. Previous devices have been signed out.
client.account.signedOut: You have signed out of this device.
client.account.localSignOut: Signed out locally. The server could not be reached; sign in on another device to revoke this session.
client.account.emailsDescription: Each verified email below can be used to recover access to your account.
client.account.encryption: Encryption: not yet enabled. This device cannot recover encrypted history.
client.account.confirmThisDevice: Revoke this device and sign out?
client.account.confirmOtherDevice: Revoke this device and end its sessions?
client.account.deviceRevoked: Device revoked. Its sessions can no longer access your account.
client.callback.heading: Completing sign-in
client.social.title: Your people
client.social.description: Organize circles and choose who belongs in each conversation.
client.social.signIn: Sign in to manage your circles and conversations.
client.social.shareCode: Share this code with someone you know so they can invite you to a circle.
client.social.circleCreated: Circle created. Invite someone using their contact code.
client.social.emptyCircles: Your circles and invitations will appear here.
client.social.circleAcceptDescription: Accept this invitation to join the circle. Joining can make you eligible for conversations that include it; messaging still requires encryption setup.
client.social.pendingDescription: Audience setup is available. Messages stay unavailable until encryption is ready.
client.social.rejoinDescription: You left this conversation. Rejoin to check your current eligibility.
client.social.encryptionDescription: Pending encryption. Messages cannot be sent or read yet.
client.social.orphaned: No eligible owner remains. Audience administration is paused.
client.social.audienceDescription: Include people or accepted members of a circle. Exclusions always win, even when someone is included in another way. Preview the audience before saving.
client.social.personPlaceholder: Your code or a contact in a shared circle
client.social.firstOwner: You are included as the conversation’s first owner.
client.social.ownerExcluded: The first owner must be included. Remove any exclusion that applies to you before creating this conversation.
client.social.saveDescription: Membership is checked again when you save. Everyone starts pending encryption.
client.social.conversationCreated: Conversation created. Messaging is pending encryption.
client.invitations.title: Invitations
client.invitations.description: Invite someone by email or accept an invitation sent to you.
client.invitations.signInDescription: Sign in to the account registered with the invited email address. If you are new, create an account with that email first, then return here and enter the invitation code.
client.invitations.acceptDescription: Use the account registered with the invited email address, then enter that email and the invitation code. If you are signed in to a different account, sign out on Your account and sign in with the invited email. We will send a separate verification code if the invitation can be used.
client.invitations.verificationSent: If this invitation can be used, a verification code has been sent to that email address. Check your inbox.
client.invitations.confirmLabel: Accept this invitation for my signed-in account
client.invitations.joinDescription: Joining a circle can also make you eligible for conversations that include it. Messaging remains unavailable until encryption is ready.
client.invitations.sendDescription: Choose a circle or conversation you manage. The recipient joins as a member after verifying their email and accepting.
client.invitations.noTargets: Create a circle or conversation first, or ask its owner for administrator access.
client.invitations.sent: Invitation sent. It grants membership only after the recipient accepts.
client.invitations.deliveryUnconfirmed: Invitation created, but delivery is not confirmed. Check its status below and resend if needed.
client.invitations.expiryDescription: Invitations expire after seven days. Emails contain no private titles, messages or member lists.
client.invitations.empty: Your sent invitations will appear here while you can manage their destinations.
client.invitations.resendDescription: Delivery is not confirmed. Resend to issue a new code and try delivery again.
client.invitations.revokeQuestion: Revoke this invitation? The recipient will no longer be able to accept it.
client.invitations.revoked: Invitation revoked. It can no longer be accepted.
client.invitations.updated: Invitation updated. Check its delivery status below; earlier invitation and verification codes no longer work.
client.invitations.refreshFailed: The latest details could not be loaded. Refresh to check them.
client.social.pendingSources_one: Pending encryption · Included by {{number}} audience source
client.social.pendingSources_other: Pending encryption · Included by {{number}} audience sources
client.error.invalidSource: Enter a complete contact or circle code.
client.invitations.confirmDescription: {{check}} I accept this invitation for my signed-in account. Only this invitation will be accepted; other invitations stay pending.
client.invitations.acceptedCircle: Invitation accepted for Circle {{id}}. Find your membership in Your circles and conversations.
client.invitations.acceptedConversation: Invitation accepted for Conversation {{id}}. Find your membership in Your circles and conversations.
client.social.pendingSources_many: Pending encryption · Included by {{number}} audience sources
client.notFound.title: Page not found
client.notFound.description: This page is unavailable. Return home to continue.
client.sync.paused: Updates paused while the app is in the background.
client.sync.scopeError: Sign in again to allow conversation updates.
client.sync.errorDescription: We could not update your circles and conversations. Try refreshing.
